_comment: Shared policy for this repository. Safe to commit. Machine-specific choices (active profile, GCP project, Ollama address) belong in shunt.local.json, which is not committed. See shunt.local.example.json.
_editPaths: Globs delegate_edit may modify. Defaults to writePaths. Widen deliberately: this lets a worker change code that already works.
_economics: Inputs to the delegation break-even. Defaults are measured over 60 real Opus sessions; the two worth tuning are assumedConversationTokens and remainingTurns, which describe how you work rather than what things cost. Raising either changes the floor: longer conversations make delegation dearer, longer-lived context makes it cheaper.
